description: Tencent Cloud TokenHub provides OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible access to Tencent Hunyuan and third-party language, multimodal, and embedding models in separately provisioned Guangzhou and Singapore services.
residency_notes: Guangzhou dispatches within mainland China; Singapore dispatches globally. Services cannot be called across regions or sites.
regional_pricing_notes: Official tables publish separate Guangzhou and Singapore prices; Guangzhou prices are CNY and Singapore prices are shown separately by Tencent Cloud.

sources.notes: Official API endpoints, authentication, model discovery, and regional restrictions.

verification.notes: Official TokenHub catalog and API surface verified; gateway routing remains disabled because no Tencent executor is configured.
